# <span id="aanchor503"></span> Close Schedules

Once a list or close group has been created, data must be scheduled for closing before it can be closed, either manually or with the Close Scheduler Service. This is done in the Close Schedule screen.

<div class="procedure">

To access Close Schedules:

1.  Go to **Setup** \> **Close Schedules**.
2.  Select the List Name or Close Group Name to close from the drop-down menu.
3.  Click the **New Sched** button.
4.  Select the Measurement Month to close from the drop-down menu.
5.  Select the close on date that the user would like the data to be closed on from the drop-down menu. This is only used by the Close Scheduler service. Once the date on the server running the Close Scheduler service has passed this date, the Close Scheduler service will try to close the data for all meters and tickets attached to Locations in the list or close group.
6.  Click **OK**. The user will then be prompted that the gas month has been successfully scheduled to be closed.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 592;height: 258;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Close Schedule Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Close Schedule screen:

- **Hold** - Place the schedule on hold and the service will ignore the scheduled Close Group until the Release Now button is clicked.

- **New Sched** - Open the Close Group Schedule Date form.

- **Release Now** - Close the data now with the Close Scheduler Service by updating the Close On date to be the current date and time.

- **Show Open** - Display all the meters that are currently open. The user can select to view the open meters by selecting All Meters or by List/Close Groups for the month and year selected in the Meters Not Closed form.

- **Close Data** - Close the selected close group immediately.

  The Close Data option requires **Meter Close - Can Schedule** and **Close Group - Can Schedule** privileges.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Meters Not Closed">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Viewing Meters That Are Not Closed</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Meters Not Closed">

<div class="procedure">

To view a list of meters that are not closed:

1.  Click the **Show Open** button.
2.  Select **All Meters** to view all open meters.
3.  To view open meters in a particular list or close group, select the **List** or **Close Group** radio button. Then select a list name or close group name from the pull down selection.
4.  Select the month and year to scan for open meters.
5.  Click **Refresh**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 532;height: 432;" />

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Considerations">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Close Schedule Considerations</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Considerations">

- Only contract months can be scheduled for closing. Users cannot schedule less than a month (May 7 - May 15, for example) for closing. Each month must be scheduled individually. For example, to close March through May, the user must schedule March, then April and then May. The order can vary (you could schedule May, then March, then April, for instance), but each month must be done individually.
- Once a month has been scheduled for closing, it can be done manually or by the close scheduler service. To close a month manually, select the month to close by clicking on the appropriate row and then click Close Data. Depending on how many meters and/or tickets attached to locations are in the list or close group, this may take some time. If the month is successfully closed, the user will be informed and the window will display the date the data was closed on. If not, the date of the failed attempt will be displayed along with the reason for the failure.
- For data being closed by the Close Service, the success or failure of the closing of the data can be monitored from this window. If a list fails to close, the user can view the reason for the failure and correct the problem. Every time the service runs, it will try to close the data until it succeeds, so once the problem is corrected, the service will close the data.
  - The Release Now button is used to close the data now with the Close Scheduler Service by updating the Close On date to be the current date and time.
  - Additionally, the following requirements need to be kept in mind when closing meter or ticket data:
  - The close date must be after the selected contract month ends.
  - There cannot be any unresolved exceptions for a meter or ticket to be closed.
  - If the option to not close a meter if it has missing data has been selected, then the meter must have data for every hour. This requirement is only for meters, not tickets.
  - If one meter in the List or Close Group cannot be closed, all other meters or tickets in the list that can be closed will be.
- If a Location has only Tickets associated with it and it is a member of a List or Close Group that is scheduled for close, then FLOWCAL's Close Data service attempts to close each ticket assigned to that Location. If a single ticket fails to close, the service continues to process all of the remaining members of the List or Close Group. Hard Closing by clicking the Close Data button in the Close Schedules Editor also closes tickets on any locations within the List or Close Group being closed. Once a ticket has been processed, the associated Location is queued to close and is processed by the Location Close Data service (FCSRVLCNCLOSEDATA.exe).

</div>
